title: RingsCylinderActuatorDisk: vortex-ring / vortex-cylinder and semi-analytical codes for the uniformly loaded actuator disc, with edge-resolved runs and Lean 4 proofs
description:
Fortran and Python codes for the uniformly loaded (Froude) actuator disc: the vortex-ring/vortex-cylinder free-wake model (V4), the uniform-load limit of Conway's semi-analytical Bessel-Laplace scheme (UNIFORM/uniform-main.f, uniform-main-edge.f, uniform-edge.f) with SciPy verification scripts, the raw runs behind Table 1 of the companion paper (UNIFORM/table-z1-runs: refinement of the first sheet node z1 = 1e-1 ... 1e-6 for the Betz load b = -4/9), the output of the free-wake ring-vortex actuator-disc code FWRV-AD of R. Bontempo for the edge-refined runs 010-014 with up to 10 000 panels and a first panel down to 3.8e-12 (FWRV-AD/runs-010-014, computed by R. Bontempo) with the scripts that derive the corresponding tables and figure of the paper, and the Lean 4 / Mathlib formalisations of Muskhelishvili's end-point theorem for a cut vortex sheet and of the weak form of Sparenberg's translation theorem (LEAN/).

Companion to: R. Bontempo, J. T. Conway, A. P. Schaffarczyk, The edge of the uniformly loaded actuator disc: edge-flow structure, regularity, and the exactness of one-dimensional momentum theory (submitted to Wind Energy Science, 2026).
